note: Cluster bootstrap: clusters (pages of <=200 consecutive txs) are resampled with replacement within each month; census months are not resampled.
pairs_note: share of a requester's sign receipts whose tx was signed by the given account (relayer); used for the FastAuth -> Sweat relayer evidence
series_note: @benchmark = accounts labeled or suspected benchmark-test in labels.yaml. structural = all requests minus benchmark/test and minus fast-auth.near (the integration being wound down).
chainGroups_note: share of requests by target: NEAR itself vs other chains vs explicit unknown (from config/chain_rules.yaml)
